A '''COMPNOR Regiment''' was a formation of assault [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]], normally attached to the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] but controlled by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] organization.<ref name="ISB" />

==Organization==
A COMPNOR Regiment was a standard formation within the [[Assault (CompForce)/Legends|Assault]] arm of [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]], the most explicitly military component of COMPNOR. Three such regiments formed the [[Auxiliary battlegroup]] attached to each [[Corps]] in the [[Imperial Army]],<ref name="ISB" /> but they could also be deployed individually, as was the case with the occupation force on [[Sedesia]].<ref name="SWAJ6">{{JournalCite|6|The Cure}}</ref>

Organizationally, the COMPNOR Regiment was modeled on a standard Imperial Army [[line regiment]].<ref name="ISB" /> This meant it had three battalions of conventional infantry (two standard [[line battalion]]s and one [[assault battalion]] with additional heavy weapons), plus one [[Repulsorlift battalion|vehicle-mounted battalion]] in which a reduced force of infantry traveled in [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] and a troop of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] were provided for reconnaissance. In situations where the use of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] technology was problematic, this battalion could be reequipped with vehicles such as [[Swift Assault 5|hoverscouts]] and [[wheelbike]]s, though the wheelbikes would not necessarily be of the same type, and the riders did not receive formal training in the use of their new mounts.<ref name="SWAJ6" />

One important difference in organization was the absence of the [[security platoon]]s assigned to battalion and regimental HQs in the Imperial Army.<ref name="ISB" /> CompForce commanders believed that these were an unnecessary addition to a well-managed and loyal unit, a notion that offended senior personnel in the regular army.<ref name="ISB" /> The result was that a COMPNOR Regiment had 3,380 personnel,<ref name="SWAJ6" /> compared with 3,530 personnel in its Imperial Army counterpart.<ref name="ISB" />
